failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, or WORKPLACES mobility declines again below -15% in the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility, despite a slight dip at t-0w, indicates that people are still spending more time at home, which will limit engagement with out-of-home retail and recreation activities, thus suppressing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, or RESIDENTIAL mobility drops below 4% for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The recent uptick in TRANSIT mobility at t-0w, if it continues and crosses a threshold of -30% from baseline in the next week, will indicate a significant increase in commuter activity, directly boosting RETAIL_REC within the next week.

failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility does not rise above -30% in the next week, or RETAIL_REC does not show a positive change within one week of the threshold being crossed.

candidate_trigger: PARKS mobility remains below 5% from baseline for two consecutive weeks after t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, or PARKS mobility rises above 10% from baseline in the next two weeks.
